serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved columns carried as ledgerBookedMin only
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available for the bucket that day; bookedMin is the authoritative booked load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until a lot is edited; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero
